reading_note: Every projection is per-unit constants measured before the stage stopped, times the target size. A stage with status != measured projects a LOWER BOUND. A stage with no projection is UNKNOWN and is never priced at zero — a consumer that substitutes 0 for an unknown has re-introduced the fail-open shape this report exists to avoid.
